name: AWR对比分析诊断
description: AWR（Automatic Workload Repository）对比分析是定位性能退化根因的最有效方法。通过对比正常时段和异常时段的 AWR 报告，快速发现 DB Time 变化、Top SQL 变化、Top 等待事件变化、执行计划变化。Oracle 提供 AWR Diff Report（awrddrpt.sql）自动对比两个时段。

root_causes.name: Top SQL 变化导致性能退化
root_causes.desc: 某条 SQL 的执行计划变化或执行频率增加，消耗了大量 DB Time。AWR Top SQL 对比可快速发现。

root_causes.name: 等待事件变化
root_causes.desc: 正常时段不存在或很少的等待事件在异常时段大量出现。如 log file sync 突然增加可能因存储问题。

root_causes.name: 系统负载变化
root_causes.desc: DB Time、逻辑读、物理读、Redo 量等整体指标变化，可能因业务量变化或批处理作业。

root_causes.name: 配置变化
root_causes.desc: 参数变更、统计信息收集、Patch 应用等配置变化导致行为改变。AWR 中的 Instance Parameters 对比可发现。

step1_awr_snapshots.desc: 查看可用的 AWR 快照
step1_awr_snapshots.sql: SELECT snap_id, begin_interval_time, end_interval_time FROM dba_hist_snapshot WHERE begin_interval_time > SYSDATE - 7 ORDER BY snap_id DESC

step2_generate_awr.sql: SELECT output FROM TABLE(DBMS_WORKLOAD_REPOSITORY.AWR_REPORT_TEXT(l_dbid => (SELECT dbid FROM v$database), l_inst_num => 1, l_bid => &begin_snap, l_eid => &end_snap))

step3_generate_diff.desc: 生成 AWR Diff 报告
step3_generate_diff.sql: SELECT output FROM TABLE(DBMS_WORKLOAD_REPOSITORY.AWR_DIFF_REPORT_TEXT(l_dbid => (SELECT dbid FROM v$database), l_inst_num => 1, l_bid1 => &normal_begin, l_eid1 => &normal_end, l_bid2 => &abnormal_begin, l_eid2 => &abnormal_end))

step4_top_sql_change.desc: 对比两个时段的 Top SQL
step4_top_sql_change.sql: SELECT sql_id, SUM(CASE WHEN snap_id BETWEEN &normal_begin AND &normal_end THEN elapsed_time_delta END) normal_elapsed, SUM(CASE WHEN snap_id BETWEEN &abnormal_begin AND &abnormal_end THEN elapsed_time_delta END) abnormal_elapsed FROM dba_hist_sqlstat WHERE snap_id BETWEEN &normal_begin AND &abnormal_end GROUP BY sql_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN snap_id BETWEEN &abnormal_begin AND &abnormal_end THEN elapsed_time_delta END) > 2 * SUM(CASE WHEN snap_id BETWEEN &normal_begin AND &normal_end THEN elapsed_time_delta END) ORDER BY abnormal_elapsed DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

step5_awr_baseline.desc: 创建 AWR Baseline 保留正常时段数据
